items.title: Preston Jackson Interview, 1973-09-07
items.q: And my supervisor's name was Gross.

ctx.x: Then you gave up the post office after all.

Yeah, I gave up the post office. Well, I had a little trouble. I'd take my leave absence for a month. I was having trouble in my stomach. But I still was trying to play whenever they'd get a job, I'd play. So the fella by the name of Henderson right there, he was a stool pigeon. He saw me going to play one night. And my supervisor's name was Gross. So he told Gross about it. And so I received a telegram stating that it is a Liz that you have two jobs. And they asked me to resign. Well, I'm fat. I got about six,…
But when they had two jobs or not, I don't see how they would make any difference.
